Core contact/sales records overlap with paid CRM use cases; reporting, workflows, quotes and integrations can require paid packs. Migration requires mapping source data and customizations; no verified one-click full migration.

CRM pipeline and lead handling are part of a broader modular ERP. Reconfigure workflows and integrations; Community lacks paid Enterprise modules and Studio. Not a full Salesforce/HubSpot suite replacement.
Contacts, opportunities, campaigns, cases and workflows cover core CRM needs. Map custom fields, automations and integrations during migration; hosted capacity limits differ from self-hosted product.

Vendor explicitly supports HubSpot/Salesforce migration through CSV or API (API recommended above 50,000 records). Rebuild existing automations/custom data models; SSO and row permissions require commercial licensing.

Fits receipt-backed expense claims, multi-level approvals and reimbursement records. Deploy Frappe HR with ERPNext and rebuild policies, employee mapping and unpaid claims. Concur travel booking, card feeds, automated receipt extraction and global payment integrations not verified; no direct migration established.

Supports Sentry client SDKs for error and basic performance monitoring. Reconfigure DSNs and validate SDK compatibility; existing Sentry issue history, replay and advanced tracing migration not established.

Developer-built commerce backend and admin with storefront starters rather than a turnkey merchant SaaS. Budget implementation of storefront and integrations; no automatic Shopify app or complete data transfer verified. Enterprise RBAC/SSO need a commercial agreement.

Another merchant storefront and back office, with responsibility for self-hosting or a separate hosting plan. Rebuild theme and integrations and validate catalog, order and customer migration. No automatic Shopify app, checkout or full-store transfer established.

Suitable for a merchant storefront on WordPress. Built-in CSV tools move product catalog data after mapping the WooCommerce schema; this is not a full-store migration. Rebuild design, checkout integrations and platform-specific apps; plan separately for orders, customers, subscriptions and URLs.

Matrix rooms, federation and encryption differ from Slack channels and app workflows. Plan identity, integration and history transfer separately; no verified one-click importer or bridge parity claimed.

Team offers channels, DMs and core search, but no group calls or guest accounts. Current Slack migration guide targets Entry/paid editions; Team import parity requires verification; integrations must be rebuilt.
Slack importer handles users/channels/messages; attachments need a separate pending-file download step and existing usernames can be skipped. Community edition limits remain.
Channel-plus-topic model differs from Slack threads; Slack export/import documented, private data availability depends on source export permissions.
Open PDF files locally for page split, merge, rotate, crop and rearrangement. Does not replace the wider conversion, text editing, signing or cloud-sharing service.

Local page-processing replacement for Smallpdf merge, split, rotate and extract tasks. No cloud account migration; retain PDF files. Basic lacks Smallpdf OCR, content editing and compression workflows.

Fits employee out-of-pocket claims, conditional approvals and settlement tracking. Deploy Frappe HR with ERPNext and rebuild policies/approvers. Spendesk cards, procurement, payment rails and integrations are broader; no direct migration or service parity established.

Best for a publication/blog. Built-in Squarespace XML migrator imports posts/pages and converts categories to tags; review redirects and rebuild design. Broader store/scheduling workflows need separate solutions.
Squarespace exports WordPress XML for selected pages and one blog. Store/portfolio pages, styles, custom CSS and several block types do not export; rebuild design and integrations.

Suitable for SQL database dashboards and exploration. Rebuild workbook layouts, calculated fields and extract-based preparation; validate dashboard interactions and supported data drivers. Planning inference: these sources document Superset-native connections and datasets, not a native importer for incumbent assets. Install DB-API driver and SQLAlchemy dialect per engine; dashboards, auth and reporting require reconfiguration.

Self-service database questions and dashboards; vendor migration guidance explicitly discusses Tableau. Rebuild workbook layouts, calculated fields and extract-based preparation; validate dashboard interactions and supported data drivers. Audit dashboards and subscriptions, centralize shared calculation logic, then rebuild and compare metrics. Data source support must be checked; embedded interactivity/SSO and subscription-specific filters require paid editions.

Use compatible Tailscale clients configured for a new Headscale control-server URL; re-register nodes and recreate policy, DNS and routes. One tailnet, small-organisation focus; no built-in web UI or promised enterprise-service parity.

Re-enrol devices with NetBird clients and recreate identities, DNS, routing and access policies. Community includes networking but enterprise provisioning, approvals and flow observability require the commercial self-hosted license; Tailscale platform extensions are not interchangeable.

Moodle covers courses, enrolment and progress tracking. Reuse original SCORM1.2/AICC packages after testing; Moodle does not generate SCORM exports. Tin Can/cmi5 parity is not established; native SCORM2004 unsupported. Rebuild branches, SSO/API links and reporting; Workplace corporate automation is commercial. No automatic history transfer verified.

Course-centric LMS with Studio authoring and self-managed operation. Rebuild courses, learner administration, SSO and integrations. Existing TalentLMS SCORM/Tin Can/cmi5 content and reporting histories require a separate compatibility/import pilot; no package parity or turnkey migration verified.

Official free importer plugin supports Toggl Track timesheet CSV; required columns and date formats must match. Reporting and invoicing available; expenses and task planning use paid plugins. Validate rates, currencies and timezones during migration.

Repository documents Toggl data import and project/task/client tracking with billable rates. Not full planning/integration parity; invoicing is excluded from Open Source. Validate imported data before switching.

Boards and task automation fit visual team workflows. Kanboard offers APIs/plugins; Trello Power-Ups and rules require rebuilding. No validated direct Trello importer in this review; no official native mobile client, responsive web UI available.

Source-available comparison only, hidden by default from OSS recommendations. Boards/cards/checklists and board import available, but Pro required for calendar, templates, public boards and exports; commercial third-party hosting and cross-organization business use restricted by license. Test import coverage before migration.

Comparable boards, lists, cards, labels, due dates and checklists. Trello Power-Ups and Butler rules require replacement; official page describes a Trello JSON/attachment downloader and import work, so test attachment import rather than assuming full migration.
Link surveys and embedded/in-app feedback overlap Typeform. Recreate Typeform forms and automations; current CE has one workspace and paid workflow/segmentation gates.
Conversational forms, logic, CSS and CSV export overlap Typeform; recreate existing forms and integrations. No verified automatic Typeform import.

Research-oriented survey workflows differ from Typeform conversational forms. Rebuild questions, branching, styling and integrations; LSS supports LimeSurvey survey interchange rather than Typeform imports.
Deploy web apps and static sites to owned infrastructure; Vercel edge/CDN, serverless integrations and managed observability require separate infrastructure or adaptation.

For structured CMS projects with developer implementation. Webflow CSV content needs mapping into Drupal; Migrate provides APIs/base implementations, not a verified automatic Webflow importer. Rebuild templates and backend behavior.

WordPress supplies a theme/plugin CMS rather than Webflow Designer. Webflow CMS collections export separately as CSV; code export omits CMS runtime, forms and ecommerce. Map content and rebuild templates/integrations.

Replace selected browser send/download workflows with own server and password-protected expiring share links, optionally allowing recipient uploads. up2k resumes chunked uploads. Existing WeTransfer links/accounts do not migrate automatically; re-upload files and issue new links. Operator owns capacity and service availability.

Persistent client accounts/groups and upload-back portals suit recurring client delivery; core includes public links and file expiration. Requires deployment and recipient access setup; export/download original files and re-upload, replacing old links. No verified automatic WeTransfer importer or equivalent anonymous send experience.

Suitable for business sites and blogs using WordPress themes and publishing. Wix site runtime cannot transfer to another host; rebuild layout and business integrations, migrate content separately. Optional plugins may be needed.
Accounting plus wider ERP workflows; configure chart of accounts, imports, localization and integrations. No tested direct migration or bank-feed parity claim.
Basic invoicing/expenses subset only; full accounting and bank automation are Enterprise features. No direct migration validated.

Visual trigger/step workflow model overlaps; rebuild incumbent automations and verify every integration/action. MIT Community paid-feature boundaries unresolved; no automatic Zap/Make import verified.
Visual node workflows overlap, but workflow/credential sharing is paid and licensing is source available. Rebuild automations and reauthorize credentials; no drop-in migration verified.

Rebuild triggers/actions as Node-RED flows; JSON flow import/export is native, but no Zap/Make importer verified. Connector availability, OAuth setup and runtime operations need checking. Best for technical operators.

Developer-oriented scripts, schedules and flow orchestration; translate integrations and code rather than import Zaps/scenarios. Build OSS source if unrestricted AGPL hosting needed; common enterprise/event features paid.

Shared support inbox and chat alternative. Community excludes voice, AI, agent capacity, SSO and SLA. Verify channel integrations and historical message import separately; no migration parity established.

Lightweight shared inbox/ticket support. Official migration guide requires API/Webhooks module; custom fields/tags need their modules. Ticket numbers cannot be preserved; imported chat threads lose messenger connection, so replies cannot reach original chat customer.

Support ticketing and workflows alternative. Official migration service supports Zendesk; migration overwrites target data, so use a fresh instance and test mapping first. Professional migration/support services may cost extra.

Email/groupware scope only. Replaces custom-domain mailbox hosting, not the full office suite. Mailcow sync jobs copy messages from IMAP; calendars, contacts, permissions and client behavior need separate migration checks. Operator manages DNS, deliverability, backups and upgrades. Source-account IMAP/export access must be enabled (Zoho Free excludes IMAP); pilot mailbox, calendar and contact transfer separately.

Email/groupware scope only. Replaces standards-based email/calendar/contact hosting, not Google or Microsoft office apps and vendor automation. Pilot IMAP/CalDAV/CardDAV migration and client behavior; vendor service migration claims do not establish a turnkey Google Workspace or Exchange Online migration. Recovery and AI mail features require Enterprise. Source-account IMAP/export access must be enabled (Zoho Free excludes IMAP); pilot mailbox, calendar and contact transfer separately.

Strongest for training and classrooms using polls, breakout rooms, and shared notes. Integrate through an LMS/front-end/API and recreate sessions/invitations. Does not replace the surrounding Workspace or Zoom suite. Dedicated Ubuntu server and operational capacity required.

Suitable for browser meetings with screen sharing and chat. Recreate meeting URLs/calendar invitations; existing incumbent links and cloud recording libraries are not automatically migrated. Recording needs Jibri; PSTN access needs Jigasi plus SIP provider. Operate and size the deployment.
